parent_objective: run the first fair public L0/L1/L2/L3 comparison pilot with fixed seeds budgets and claim scope
blocked_by: M1198 pre-registers the comparison protocol but no fair multi-seed pilot has run
supersedes: using M1196 or M1197 smoke metrics as comparison evidence
invalidates: claiming profile trends without fixed seeds budgets and eval protocol

public_gates: M1199 may run the public fair comparison pilot only
M1199 may run PPO under the fixed M1198 profile budgets and seeds
M1199 must not use private holdout
M1199 must not tune profiles based on results
M1199 must not run candidate replay
M1199 must not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
M1199 must not claim paper-level evidence or self-identification
forbidden_shortcuts: do not run public proof replay as if this were a driver candidate
do not tune hyperparameters after seeing profile results
do not add hidden or oracle actor inputs
do not claim recurrent-belief advantage or self-identification

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: runs the first fixed-protocol public pilot to decide which profile families warrant deeper training and evaluation
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: public pilot trend only; no promotion private-holdout paper-level generalization recurrent-belief or self-identification claim
stop_condition: stop if any profile cannot run the fixed protocol
stop if protocol changes after seeing a profile result
stop if runtime exceeds the public pilot resource cap
fallback_plan: if full pilot is too costly, report a resource failure and route to smaller L0/L1/L2_window_25/L3 pilot
if one profile fails, record failure and route to focused repair before any comparison claim
if metrics are too weak or missing, route to evaluation-metric implementation before repeating
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1198 pre-registered fair comparison controls and M1199 is the first public pilot run

admission_evidence: M1196 and M1197 behavior pretrain smoke prove train-loop plumbing for generated profiles
M1185/M1186 establish active public gate policy and keep proof gates separate from this public pilot
M1198 fixes rollback protection: no promotion, no private holdout, no per-profile tuning, and repair route if any profile fails
current public base remains unchanged; M1199 checkpoints are pilot artifacts only
blocked_shortcuts: do not make paper-level or self-ID claims
allowed_updates: status, queue, scoreboard, research log, review, and next manifest
next_stage_criteria: all selected profiles run with fixed budgets
profile seed rows and aggregate rows are recorded
claim scope remains public pilot only
next repeat longer-budget or repair milestone is selected

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: M1199 can only support public closed-loop reactive/profile trend evidence; it does not isolate history necessity.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: Profiles have different temporal inputs, but the pilot does not construct same-current or delayed-history tests.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If L2 or L3 do not outperform L0/L1, record that as public pilot evidence and do not weaken recurrent-belief claim standards.
allowed_claims: closed-loop training/eval smoke with fixed public seeds
no recurrent-belief, strong self-identification, promotion, private-holdout, real-vehicle, or paper-result claim

hypothesis: A fixed-protocol public pilot can produce useful L0/L1/L2/L3 trend evidence without per-profile tuning or claim expansion.
success_criteria: all selected profile seed runs complete or failures are recorded
no promotion or actor-input contract change occurs
claims are limited to public pilot trends
failure_criteria: profile-specific budgets or hyperparameters change after seeing results
metrics are framed as paper-level evidence
hidden or oracle actor inputs are introduced
failed profiles are omitted from summary

commands.name: run_fair_comparison_pilot
commands.command: run fixed public L0/L1/L2/L3 comparison pilot with equal seeds budgets and eval protocol

decision_rule: M1199 passes if the fixed public pilot runs or records failures without claim expansion or protocol drift.
